notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Sporeweb Weaver indestructible.
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
description:
Give Sporeweb Weaver indestructible, if needed, then cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing damage equal to the creature's power to Sporeweb Weaver.
Sporeweb Weaver triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing damage equal to the Saproling's power to Sporeweb Weaver.
Repeat from step 3.
